scope: Explicit read-only data access after controlled mount loss, known live-writer refusal, unrelated live peer and completion reconciliation without mount replay. No application consistency, writable restore or host reboot qualification.

policy.original: Owner-selected recovery UUID and original storage receipt digest; verify completed schema-2 storage, actual engine/root/backing file, filesystem UUID, effective retained reservation and role inodes.
policy.view: Mount ro,noload with nosuid/nodev/noexec, validate primary mount and identical read-only root aliases. Reuse one exact retained loop, or request a read-only loop if none exists. No formatting or journal replay.
policy.writers: Refuse target container references, automatic restart, live privileged/device-enabled containers and referenced unknown volume plugins. Ordinary unrelated peers continue; host administrators remain outside this coordination boundary.
policy.unknown: Durable intent and global fence precede mount effects. Never repeat an uncertain mount. Explicit reconciliation verifies an actual read-only view and acknowledges it without mounting. Foreign fences and partial/invalid records refuse.
policy.execution: Recovery receipts are distinct from provisioning receipts. Ordinary storage inspection and fresh startup refuse the read-only mount. All storage charges, data and physical resources remain retained.

linuxHost.scope: Owned temporary metadata, injected mount/loop effects, real process exclusion and one existing 4 KiB native allocation case. Covers writer aliases, read-only loop creation/refusal, unknown outcomes, reconciliation, quarantine and host bind aliases; no actual mounts or loop changes.
